Nội dung chi tiết:
You have received an email from your English-speaking friend asking about the new house you recently moved into. Read part of the email below:

"Congratulations on moving into your new home! I would love to hear all about it. Where is your new house located, and what is the neighborhood like? I heard it even has a large garden—what do you plan to do with that space? Write back soon!"

Write an informal email responding to your friend.

body.answer: I would like to give you information on my new house, which is located in a quiet suburb about twenty minutes from the city center.
body.example: It is near a main bus stop and only a ten-minute ride from a big supermarket and a park.
body.reason: Living slightly outside the center fits comfortably within my budget while still being fast and convenient to travel to school or work.

body.reason: Unlike crowded, noisy public venues downtown, this area gives us a quiet, cozy environment where we can relieve stress and build a strong sense of belonging with neighbors.

body.reason: Fresh organic vegetables play an essential role in maintaining our family's health, and green plants make a great contribution to protecting the environment.

Tiêu đề đề bài: Task 2.1: Parental Pressure via Social Media on Teachers: Effects and Solutions
Nội dung chi tiết:
Read the following statement:

"Nowadays, many parents frequently share stories and opinions about school and education issues on social media platforms. Education experts warn that teachers are facing greater pressure than ever before, which can strain the relationship between schools, families, and local communities."

Write an essay to an educated reader discussing the effects of this trend and proposing practical solutions to strengthen cooperation between communities, teachers, and parents. Support your arguments with specific reasons and examples.
title: Task 2.1: Parental Pressure via Social Media on Teachers: Effects and Solutions
content:
Read the following statement:

"Nowadays, many parents frequently share stories and opinions about school and education issues on social media platforms. Education experts warn that teachers are facing greater pressure than ever before, which can strain the relationship between schools, families, and local communities."

Write an essay to an educated reader discussing the effects of this trend and proposing practical solutions to strengthen cooperation between communities, teachers, and parents. Support your arguments with specific reasons and examples.

body1.example: For instance, my brother was working hard as a young secondary school teacher last semester. Therefore, he decided to give extra homework to help weak students before exams, but a parent posted an angry complaint about him on Facebook. As a result, he finally felt deeply stressed and lost confidence in class. If he had not received kind support from his principal, he would not have been able to continue teaching calmly.
body1.focus: Effects: Heavy pressure on teachers and weaker school-family trust
body1.frame: Mở: First and foremost, parents sharing school complaints on social media leads to several serious negative effects | Ruột ĐOẠN 1 | Chốt: Clearly, these are the key impacts of parents sharing school complaints on social media.
body1.point: A very important point to consider is that public complaints online put heavy mental pressure on teachers and hurt their motivation. This means that even small misunderstandings in class can turn into stressful online arguments that damage a teacher's reputation. Another point I would like to make is that this habit weakens trust between schools, families, and local communities. This is because of the fact that online criticism replaces respectful face-to-face interaction and makes parents and teachers view each other with doubt.

body2.example: For example, schools can hold regular parent-teacher meetings and open a private feedback email, while parents choose calm face-to-face talks with teachers instead of posting angry comments online.
body2.focus: Practical solutions: Direct communication, clear school channels, and education
body2.frame: Mở: In order to resolve such problems, both individuals and organizations should take practical measures | Ruột Solutions (Cá nhân + Tổ chức + Education)
body2.point: One primary solution would be that individuals, especially parents, should stay on the safe side and think things through calmly by talking directly with teachers before posting anything online. In addition, schools and local communities need to set clear communication channels, hold regular parent-teacher meetings, and apply fair rules against unfair online attacks. Above all, education plays a key role in tackling this issue, because people need to be aware of its impacts so that they can act responsibly.

hint.conclusion: In conclusion, parents sharing complaints about schools on social media is closely linked to heavy teacher stress and broken school-family trust and requires practical steps such as direct parent-teacher talks and clear communication channels. Therefore, both schools and families need to take steady, practical actions to reduce this problem in the long run.
